meta.name: esm
meta.description: Use when working directly with the `esm` Python SDK, ESM3 or ESMC model IDs, Forge/Biohub inference clients, or ESMFold2 folding workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用ESM模型进行蛋白质序列分析与结构预测
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用ESM SDK做蛋白质折叠或序列研究
copy.tagline_en: Analyze protein sequences and predict structures with ESM models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with ESM SDK for protein folding or sequence research

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你用 Python 代码调用 ESM 模型来生成蛋白质序列、预测结构、获取嵌入向量，以及进行功能注释和批量处理。
howto.when: 当你需要设计或分析蛋白质，比如生成新序列、预测结构、计算相似性，或者使用 ESM3、ESMC、ESMFold2 等模型时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 ESM3 生成一段 200 个氨基酸的荧光蛋白序列。
say.note: Claude 会给出 Python 代码示例。

say.text: 如何用 ESMC 计算两个蛋白质序列的嵌入向量？
say.note: Claude 会提供代码和解释。

say.text: 用 ESMFold2 预测这个序列的结构：MPRTKEIND...
say.note: Claude 会生成结构预测代码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you use Python code to call ESM models for generating protein sequences, predicting structures, obtaining embeddings, and performing function annotation and batch processing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to design or analyze proteins, such as generating new sequences, predicting structures, computing similarities, or using ESM3, ESMC, or ESMFold2 models.

say_en.text: Help me generate a 200-residue fluorescent protein sequence using ESM3.
How to compute embeddings for two protein sequences with ESMC?
say_en.note: Claude will provide code and explanation.

say_en.text: Predict the structure of this sequence using ESMFold2: MPRTKEIND...
say_en.note: Claude will generate structure prediction code.
